{{Quote|Good to see you again, it is! Go now, fun you must have!|Yoda|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
The '''Officers' Club''' was a restricted lounge in which the [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] could enjoy moments of relaxation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was located in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], headquarters of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. A band led by an [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Nalargon/Legends|nalargon]] player often performed there, and so did a [[Unidentified Human dancer|Human dancer]]. A dimly lit room, the Officers' Club also featured arcade games and a bar. Various trophies were displayed on shelves, and a damaged [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] was left hanging from the ceiling as a decoration.
